title: PORT-BRANCH-parked-agent-clockwork: carry parked/agent/CLOCKWORK onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `parked/agent/CLOCKWORK` at 965a566192 holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: doctrine/growth.json, foundation/__main__.py, foundation/clockwork.py, instances/ultrastable/loop-registry.json)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried parked/agent/CLOCKWORK
**Status:** closed

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 2 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried parked/agent/CLOCKWORK

**Evidence:** Superseded: main has foundation/clockwork.py (CLOCKWORK-2, stages, catch-up, settlement, escalation) over doctrine/clocks.json, a later design than the branch's CLOCKWORK-1 doctrine/clockwork.json; the four Q-GROW items exist on main (docs/issues/Q-GROW-*.json) and growth experiments live in doctrine/growth.json and foundation/growth.py.
